reasons.plausibility: The underlying metallurgy (phase stabilization by Ta, Nb, V additions) is generally sound for a high-entropy HfZrTi-based system, though it does not address Q235 steel corrosion.
reasons.testability: They outline concrete structural and mechanical tests (XRD, EBSD, TEM, mechanical, SHPB) that could confirm or refute phase evolution and performance, so it is testable on its own terms.
reasons.usefulness: It focuses on high-entropy alloy phase transformations and mechanical/oxidation behavior, thus not answering the Q235 corrosion question and offering limited utility for that topic.
